column1: # Vícios de texto gerado por IA em inglês.
# Trechos entre aspas, código e links não são examinados.

column3: Empty contrast: the negative half denies what nobody claimed. State the point. If the contrast is real and planned, declare 'recurso: contraste' on the page.

column2: \b(?:i hope this helps|great question|let me know if|feel free to|would you like me to|want me to)\b
column3: Chat residue. Remove it: the material speaks to the audience.

column2: \b(?:let'?s dive in|let'?s explore|let'?s break (?:this|it) down|here'?s what you need to know|without further ado|here'?s the thing)\b
column3: Announcement of what comes next. Start with the point.

column2: \b(?:it'?s worth noting|it is worth noting|it'?s important to note|it is important to note|it should be noted)\b
column3: Importance signal. Drop the phrase and keep the claim.

column2: \b(?:as an ai|as a language model|as of my last (?:training )?update|based on (?:the )?available information)\b
column3: Assistant talking about its own knowledge. Say what the source shows or cut.
Unnamed authority. Cite the source (E-nnn) or cut the claim.
Generic opening. Start from this audience's situation.

column2: \b(?:the real question is|at its core|what really matters|the heart of the matter)\b
column3: Phrase that promises depth. Write the specific claim.
Showcase word. Say what the thing does, with a number or an example.

column2: \b(?:plays a (?:key|crucial|vital|pivotal) role|stands as|serves as|setting the stage for|evolving landscape|marks a (?:pivotal|significant))\b
column3: Inflated significance. Keep the fact and show the consequence.
Filler connector. Check whether the sentence stands without it.
Trailing -ing phrase. State the consequence in its own sentence if the source supports it.
Stacked hedge. Keep one, and only if the source calls for it.
